summary: A Buncombe County Library program at the Weaverville branch offering Dungeons & Dragons sessions for tweens/teens ages 12-18, run by library staff. Both listed sessions describe it identically as open to 'all skill levels' with simple phone/in-person registration required only because space is limited, not because of a fixed roster. No campaign, membership, DM name, or outside community presence (Facebook, Discord, Meetup) is referenced anywhere.

evidence.note: Listing text is generic recruitment language ('Calling adventurous tweens/teens!... All skill levels are welcome'), not membership or campaign language.

Second session six days later uses the identical boilerplate description ('open to tweens and teens ages 12-18, all skill levels welcome'), suggesting a repeating drop-in program format rather than one continuing campaign with a fixed party.
Registration is required only because 'space for this program is limited,' arranged by calling the library or stopping by in person; there is no sign-up form, roster, dues, or club name given.
Organizer is Buncombe County Library staff running a library youth program, not a community-run or peer-led group; no named Dungeon Master, regulars, or returning-player language appears.

Web search budget was exhausted this session (200/200 used) and a direct WebFetch of the listing URL and the library's public calendar site turned up no additional D&D-specific page, Facebook group, or Meetup presence.
